name: studio-ui-patterns
title_zh: 照着 Supabase 官方后台的组件库改界面
tagline_zh: 改后台界面最怕风格跑偏——直接调用官方设计系统的现成模式，按钮、表格、弹窗的间距和配色一步到位，不用自己猜。
tagline_en: Stop guessing admin UI styles. Pull Supabase Studio's own design-system patterns for buttons, tables, and dialogs.
desc_en: Design system UI patterns for Supabase Studio. Use when building or updating
why_zh: 不是样式碎片，是官方后台在用的完整交互模式，连空状态、加载骨架、错误提示都替你定好了。
why_en: Not just CSS snippets — full interaction patterns from the real Studio app, including empty states, skeletons, and error toasts.
limit_zh: 只认 Supabase Studio 的设计语言，换到别的 React 后台要自己改主题变量；且只给模式参考。
limit_en: Only for Supabase Studio's design language; other React admin themes need manual variable overrides. Provides patterns, not full page code.
title_en: Supabase Studio UI patterns for your own admin panels
